content.text:
Answer: Sci/Tech is more common than World

The file gives no labels, so I classified the 341 articles myself with keyword matching. Because of that, I don't have exact counts. The rough result was about 160 Sci/Tech against about 55 World. The keywords misfire on some sports and business items. Even so, the gap is wide enough that I'm confident in the direction.
